name: VitaDL
long_description: VitaDL is a small program which can download any file from a given HTTP link. Useful for if you're wanting to download something straight to your Vita that you can't normally view or download in the regular Web Browser app. (e.g. a VPK or a ZIP).
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
